fee_notes: Fee depends on number of territories purchased. Single territory: $59,500; 2 territories cumulative: $99,500; 3 territories: $134,500; 4 territories: $164,500; 5 territories: $194,500. Each territory covers ~2,000 businesses with 20+ employees. If cumulative businesses exceed the tier maximum, an overage fee of $25.00–$17.00 per additional qualified employer applies depending on tier. A 15% discount is offered to U.S. Armed Forces veterans on the cumulative Initial Franchise Fee. Fee is fully earned, due in lump sum at signing, and non-refundable. Note: an initial inventory of 6 Break Coffee Beverage Machines is also required at signing ($20,000–$25,000), but is treated separately from the Initial Franchise Fee.
raw_excerpt:
You must pay an initial franchise fee ("Initial Franchise Fee") when you sign the Franchise Agreement, which is included in this Disclosure Document in Exhibit B. The amount of the Initial Franchise Fee will depend on the number of territories you purchase and is calculated as follows:

Territory Number | Cumulative Initial Franchise Fee | Individual Initial Franchise Fee | Cumulative Number of Businesses Maximum
1 | $59,500 | $59,500 | 2,000
2 | $99,500 | $40,000 | 4,000
3 | $134,500 | $35,000 | 6,000
4 | $164,500 | $30,000 | 8,000
5 | $194,500 | $30,000 | 10,000

The entire cumulative Initial Franchise Fee is fully earned by us and due in lump sum when you sign the Franchise Agreement. The Initial Franchise is non-refundable.
